bullets.text: Camera Clash: iPhone vs Oppo - The **Oppo Find X9 Pro** outshines the **iPhone 17 Pro** in photography tests.
AI Image Revolution - **Google's Nano Banana Pro** sets a new standard in AI image generation with stunning realism.
Festive Innovation: Apple Lights Up - **Apple** showcases winning iPad designs on **Battersea Power Station** this Christmas.
Netflix's Bold Move - **Netflix** secures **Warner Bros.** in an $82.7 billion deal after talks with Trump.
Autonomous Vehicle Surge - **Waymo** and others ramp up robotaxi services, despite rising scrutiny and incidents.
X's EU Fallout - **X** deactivates the European Commission's ad account following a €120 million fine.
